description: This file declares functions and macros related to filesystem operations, such as checking file existence, opening, reading, writing files, and manipulating file names, for use in a C project with WebAssembly imports.

methods.name: lu5_name_without_extention
methods.description: Returns a new allocated string with the filename without its extension.

methods.name: lu5_open_file
methods.description: Opens a file with specified mode, designed to handle errors, imported from WebAssembly environment.

methods.name: lu5_write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file, imported from WebAssembly environment.

methods.name: lu5_read_file
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a buffer which must be freed by the caller, imported from WebAssembly environment.
